primary_question: Does transport supervision improve chemically independent biological prediction over capacity-matched structure/context and conventional baselines?
primary_analysis: verified source-cell cohort; BAF only unless further eligible evidence is independently verified
selection: fixed archived architecture and budgets; no selection on outer outcomes; no claim of nested hyperparameter tuning
strict_upstream_exclusion: all chemically novel test IDs excluded from both transport stages and preprocessing
source_independence: DOI grouping; known-chemical source transfer differs from new-chemical transfer
primary_metric: equal-chemical MAE; also record MAE RMSE prediction R2 Spearman and paired cluster uncertainty
limitations: Previously used external sources remain retrospective, not untouched prospective tests
Transport supervision contains calculated properties and is not wholly experimental
No outcome-directed source inclusion or exclusion
